notes.title: v 0.3.2 Update
notes.content:
v 0.3.2 Update
[list]
[*] Adjusted the positions of two rooms
Fixed an issue where loading a save caused a loss of 5 yuan, requiring players to backtrack through previous rooms
[/list]

notes.title: v 0.3.1 Update
notes.content:
Game Adjustments
[list]
[*] Optimized exit UI in the Lightbulb Room
[*] Removed elevator platform levels and replaced with bonsai
[*] Removed early lock-breaking design using cardboard boxes
[/list]

Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed freezing issue when entering far right side of Copper Pipe map
[*] Fixed power outage issue in Ice Copper Pipe level
[/list]

notes.title: v0.3.0 Update Notes
notes.content:
Game Adjustments
[list]
[*] Reduced explosion damage range during boss battles.
[*] Decreased the number of flying units in boss battles.
[*] Adjusted the movement logic of spikes in Phase 2 of boss battles.
[*] Fixed an issue where shooting mode remained active and unresponsive during story cutscenes.
[*] Changed a texture from an iron door to a wooden door.
[*] Adjusted the orientation of the volume control UI.
[/list]

Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed a black screen error when entering the underground entrance a second time in the hotel room.
[*] Fixed an impassable copper pipe in a specific area.
[*] Resolved a freeze when interacting with a copper pipe overlapping spikes and obstacles using the mouse.
[*] Fixed texture issues with boxes and windows.
[*] Fixed the "Investigate E" UI persisting after opening a box.
[*] Fixed a bug where the character spawns inside a wall when returning to the hotel room later in the game.
[*] Addressed abnormal behavior of elevators during battery charging.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.2.8 Update Notes
notes.content:
v0.2.8 Update Notes

[list]
[*] Fixed a black screen error when entering the basement entrance a second time in the hotel room.
[*] Adjusted an impassable copper pipe obstruction in a specific area.
[*] Fixed a freeze issue when attempting to pick up copper pipes and barricades stacked on spikes with the mouse.
[*] Repaired textures for crates and windows.
[*] Fixed an issue where the "Investigate [E]" UI remained visible after opening a crate.
[/list]

notes.title: Illusion Box Now Available
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We are thrilled to announce the official release of "Illusion Box"!

This retro-inspired yet innovatively crafted game lives up to its name, offering a truly magical illusion-like experience. We've poured our hearts into creating something that sparks joy and wonder during your gameplay. We sincerely hope you'll love this creation.

If you enjoy "Illusion Box", your support through writing a review or recommending it to friends would mean the world to us. Every player's voice fuels our passion, and we're deeply grateful for your involvement.

Should you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please don't hesitate to contact us through the feedback channel. We'll address them promptly.

Wishing you an enchanting gaming journey!
